# HubSpot Offers

> > HubSpot Offers provides free AI-powered toolkits, playbooks, and templates for marketers, sales leaders, and business professionals to implement cutting-edge strategies and automation.

HubSpot Offers is a resource hub featuring downloadable guides, databases, and training materials focused on AI adoption, sales productivity, marketing automation, and leadership development. The site aggregates expert insights, case studies, and practical toolkits from industry leaders and HubSpot's content partnerships.

## Key Topics

- AI Marketing
- ChatGPT Prompts
- Sales Automation
- AI Agents
- Cold Calling
- Customer Service
- Net Promoter Score
- AI Content Creation
- Sales Leadership
- AI Disruption
- Startup Strategy
- Marketing Automation
- Free Resources
- AI Adoption
- Sales Productivity

## AI Marketing & Content

- [2025 AI Trends for Marketers](https://offers.hubspot.com/ai-marketing): Report on AI trends from 1,000+ marketers with 2025 insights.
- [Free Download: Full Stack AI Markting Toolkit](https://offers.hubspot.com/full-stack-ai-marketing): AI marketing toolkit for content creation across multiple channels.
- [HubSpot's AI Content for Marketers: From Idea to Publish with Jasper](https://offers.hubspot.com/ai-content-marketers-jasper): Jasper guide with 12 strategies and 36 prompts for AI content.
- [Free Download: Master AI Agents in 2025](https://offers.hubspot.com/ai-agents-playbook): Playbook for implementing AI agents in marketing and sales.

## Sales Enablement & Productivity

- [The ChatGPT Sales Email System: 80 Ready-To-Use Prompts](https://offers.hubspot.com/chatgpt-sales-email-system): ChatGPT guide with 80 prompts for personalized sales emails.
- [The Science of Scaling Cold Calling Essentials](https://offers.hubspot.com/science-of-scaling-cold-calls): Cold calling guide with script templates and objection handling.
- [Sales Leader's AI Disruption Database: 65 Patterns Across Industries](https://offers.hubspot.com/science-of-scaling-ai-database): Database of 50+ AI disruptions across industries for sales leaders.
- [Steal Sam Parr's AI System: Turn ChatGPT Into Your Executive Coach](https://offers.hubspot.com/mfm-chatgpt-executive-coach): Guide on using ChatGPT as personal executive coach and advisor.

## Customer Experience & Service

- [Free Net Promoter Score (NPS) Kit [Calculator + Template]](https://offers.hubspot.com/net-promoter-score-kit): NPS calculator and template for customer loyalty measurement.
- [How to Analyze Customer Reviews with AI](https://offers.hubspot.com/ai-customer-review-analysis): 5-step AI process for extracting and analyzing customer insights.
- [Free Customer Service Training Manual Template](https://offers.hubspot.com/customer-service-training-manual-template): Customizable customer service training and onboarding template.

## Business Strategy & Leadership

- [MFM's AI Business Playbook: 7 Startups Making Millions](https://offers.hubspot.com/mfm-ai-business-playbook): Case studies and playbooks from 7 multimillion-dollar AI startups.
- [The Science of Scaling's Five Pivots That Built Today's Giants](https://offers.hubspot.com/science-of-scaling-five-sales-pivots): Startup pivot strategies from companies like Brex and Mistral AI.
- [How to Spot $100M+ Product Ideas with Eric Ryan](https://offers.hubspot.com/eric-ryan-product-ideas): Product ideation frameworks from CPG expert Eric Ryan.
- [Masters in Marketing's The Space Makers](https://offers.hubspot.com/marketing-space-makers): Marketing leadership insights with 25 AI prompts for careers.

## Workplace & Team Development

- [How to Motivate & Manage Millennials [Free Access]](https://offers.hubspot.com/how-to-motivate-and-manage-millennials): Report on workplace motivation drivers for Millennial employees.
- [Smart Workplace Communicator Database [Free Access]](https://offers.hubspot.com/workplace-communicator-database): 150+ message templates for workplace communication scenarios.

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Sales | HubSpot's Software](https://offers.hubspot.com/contact-sales): Contact HubSpot sales team via call, chat, or meeting booking.
